title: Random walk on sphere packings and Delaunay triangulations in arbitrary dimension
abstract: A Lean 4 formalization of the paper "Random walk on sphere packings and Delaunay triangulations in arbitrary dimension" by Bou-Rabee and Gwynne: on orthogonal tilings with small mesh and one of three regularity hypotheses, the stopped conductance-weighted random walk converges to stopped Brownian motion modulo time parametrization (Theorem A) and the discrete Dirichlet problem converges (Theorem B, both alternatives); Poisson-Voronoi tessellations satisfy the hypotheses (Proposition 1.1); and simple random walk on a bounded-degree sphere packing need not converge (Theorem 6.1); for any nearest-neighbour walks under Assumption D the stopped walk converges to stopped Brownian motion (Theorem 4.1). Every labelled result is registered and proved, as printed or as in the corrected paper (paper/rw-spheres-corrected.tex), where the printed statement is false, not well defined, or changed with the published version open (README.md); Lemma 5.1(b) is registered with dimension-dependent constants, which is weaker than the printed statement in dimensions 4 to 12, where the printed radius also holds but is not needed. Theorem A and Theorem B(a) are Leonardo Bonanno's (leobon12) formalization, imported with attribution.
